kind: loop 7 preregistration (package preparation only; all T4 stages run later on Kaggle)
device: package preparation on CPU (Apple M5 MacBook Pro, py3.11.15 .venv-stage1)

scope.numbers_recorded_by_this_loop: CPU unit-test outcomes and file hashes only; every T4 number comes later from the runner's own per-stage JSONs on Kaggle

checks: SHA256 of both safetensors files matches revision.json

gates.name: vision_outputs_finite
gates.rule: vision tower output has no inf/NaN; on failure rerun once with vision_fp32 fallback config and record which config ran; if the fallback also fails, abort

resume_stage.purpose: prove checkpoint/reload continuity because a real 463,932-caption run exceeds the Kaggle 12h session limit
plan: new process: resume from step-25 checkpoint, continue to 50
rerun steps 0-25 with continue-beyond-25 logic (same seed) to get uninterrupted steps 0-50

gates.name: lr_schedule_continuity
gates.rule: resumed per-step LR equals uninterrupted per-step LR within 1e-12 relative

gates.name: optimizer_state_continuity
gates.rule: optimizer state tensors equal elementwise (exact) after reload

resume_stage.scheduler_steps_definition: 50 total, cosine over 50, 3% warmup (ceil(1.5) = 2 steps), identical in interrupted and uninterrupted runs

overfit_stage.step_sizing_rule: N = floor(20*60 / (smoke seconds per optimizer step)) = floor(1200 * smoke samples_per_second / 8); recorded in the stage JSON; not tuned after the run starts

gates.name: final_loss_ratio
gates.rule: final optimizer-step mean loss <= 0.2 x initial optimizer-step mean loss

gates.name: no_nan
gates.rule: every micro-batch loss finite; final status completed

gates.name: no_early_spike
gates.rule: no optimizer-step mean loss > 2x the first optimizer-step mean loss within the first 50 optimizer steps

gates.name: greedy_decode_reproduction
gates.rule: greedy decode of >= 12 of 16 patch captions reproduces the package caption (normalized: lowercase, collapse whitespace); model falls back to the vision-fp32 config for generation if the fp16 vision output is nonfinite

gates.name: image_shuffle_control
gates.rule: mean loss on 16 caption-paired shuffled-image patches > 1.10 x mean loss on the 16 true-image patches measured in the same session with identical decoding

overfit_stage.shuffle_control_threshold_rationale: guard against a 1.10x pass driven by noise; the ratio must also be recorded

extrapolate_stage.ddp_note: 2xT4 DDP is NOT included; include only if a measured DDP run exists
extrapolate_stage.no_gate: this stage records a number only and cannot fail the package

weights_source_options: HF hub download at pinned revision (internet ON at session start)
private Kaggle dataset of the pinned weights (internet OFF)
